title: Rules digest JSON (rules/<CODE>/digest/*.json)
description: Version 0.1.0 (2026-10-21). The envelope every rules digest shares, so code can rely on it and nothing else ships by accident (review 2026-10-20, M4). The content is the rules as data, in our own words (rules/README.md): labels, numbers and element numbers, never the Code's sentences. schema/test_digests.py adds what a schema can't say: code equals the folder name, and every block of rules carries a citation.

code.description: The rules edition: the name of the folder under rules/ (e.g. UCG-WAG, WG-MAG-2025).

about.description: What the file holds, in a sentence or two.

source.description: The document the whole file comes from, where one does.

cite.description: Where in the source a block's claims are, e.g. 'p. 14 §6.3' or 'IR §III.B.3'.
